basic_info.description: Located on the NW corner of MIRA, this 2-bed, 2-bath residence showcases walls of windows framing sweeping city views. Residence 9A is one of a small number of homes with a landscaped private terrace with lush planting. Creating a seamless transition between indoors and outdoors, the well-proportioned garden expands usable living areas.  The open-concept living and dining spaces are bathed in natural light from expansive windows and offer terrace and panoramic city views. The kitchen is outfitted with a central island featuring wine storage, SOZO Studio soft-close cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, and a premium Miele appliance suite.  The expansive primary suite offers dual walk-in closets, seating area, and spa-inspired bath appointed with Italian porcelain tile, Kohler fixtures, glass-enclosed shower, tub, and dual vanities with a backlit mirror.  At the opposite end of the home, a well-proportioned guest bedroom offers privacy and an adjacent full bath. Hardwood floors, air-conditioning, and in-home laundry complete this sought-after downtown condominium.  Located steps from SF's dynamic waterfront, MIRA amenities include 24-hour concierge, fitness center, private dining rooms, rooftop terrace, valet parking, and more.
